Bright, Kotsireas, Ganesh, Enumeration of Williamson sequences divisible by 2 or 3, Zenodo (2018), file williamson-22.txt, sha256 a689bbdf1d4efe783f0bd028171a6cedd67e8cc400cc8602174d1a4285c7621f

notes: 432 quadruples, no two equivalent: every class under the board's equivalence inside the 15 published classes of the cited enumeration. They were obtained from the one quadruple per class in the authors' dataset by applying the two operations the published equivalence has and the board's does not, the cyclic shift of a single block by n/2 and the negation of every second entry of all four blocks, and are stored in canonical form. The list is complete exactly when the published classification is. No search was rerun for this entry, so the count is a lower bound here.
